allDown.title: All hosts are down
allDown.body: The service is temporarily unavailable — we're on it. Your downloaded music is available in the offline library.

blocked.title: Can't reach the app's servers
blocked.body: The internet works, but no request gets through to our servers, not even over the backup routes. This usually means a provider block or a local bypass tool such as zapret or a VPN. Your downloaded music is available in the offline library.
blocked.rule: If the app works with zapret turned off, add scnative.space to list-exclude. If your provider blocks it, add scnative.space to list-general: that also covers *.relay.scnative.space.
